title: Quintic honesty collector connection
objective: Generalize prepared collector input export for frozen quintic panel row 21 and drive all six successful honesty scheduler decisions from actual Sage.js no-cache collector outputs

handoff.summary: Completed and authenticated a pristine PARI 2.17.4 exporter for frozen quintic panel row 21. It exports the complete prepared-number-field and factor-base inputs for all six successful honesty ideals. Fresh actual CPython collector calls are transactional but execute zero probes because the connected ranked-LLL graph rejects degree five before collection; therefore no PARI-derived answers were connected to the scheduler.
risks: The honesty success fixture still uses frozen oracle observations because Sage.js cannot yet produce a degree-5 collector probe.
Removing only the first n > 4 check would be unsound: integer rank, LLL selection, and FLATTER retain connected degree limits.
next_steps: Generalize the ranked integer-rank, LLL selection, FLATTER, and ranked-basis primitive graph to degree five against the exported row-21 input.
Rerun all six fresh collector calls through CPython and native backends, then connect their actual observations to the honesty scheduler.
